lawyer: Asrarul Hossain with Iftekhar Ahmed, Advocates ----- For the Appellants
parties:
MAC, Proprietor Mahtabuddin Chowdhury and another ------ Appellant
vs
Agrani Bank, Thatari Branch Dhaka ------ Respondents
full_judgment:
Mahmudul Amin Choudhury J: This petition of appeal has been preferred against the Judgment and order dated 20.1.94 passed by the learned Artha Rin Adalat No. 1 and Subordinate Judge, Dhaka in Miscellaneous Case No. 26 of 1992. The Artha Rin Adalat by the said order dismissed the Misc. Case No. 26 of 1992 filed under Order 9 rule 13 of the Code of Civil Procedure. 

 2. The appellant-petitioners case, in short, is that the respondent instituted Title Suit No. 37 of 1989 before the Commercial Court for realization of Taka 12, 35,130.00 from the present appellant and that suit was ultimately decreed ex parte. Thereafter the present appellants filed the aforesaid Misc. Case under Order 9 rule 13 of the Code of Civil Procedure alleging that the summons were suppressed at the instance of the plaintiff 

 3. Before the trial Court the respondent also entered appearance and contested the case by filing a written objection and their case is that the summon were duly served. The Artha Rin Adalat then by the impugned order dated 20.1.94 dismissed the Misc. Case on contest. 

 From these two provisions the learned Advocate tried to impress that all the provisions of the Code of-Civil Procedure have been made applicable in a case filed undet Artha Rin Adalat Ain. For further appreciation let us quote here the provision of section 6 which provides as follows: 

 It appears that the provision of Order IX rule 13 of the Code of Civil Procedure has been made applicable on certain conditions in a proceeding filed before the Artha Rin Adalat. So from all these aforesaid it appears that all the provisions of the Code of Civil Procedure have not been made applicable in a proceeding filed before the Artha Rin Adalat constituted under this Artha Rin Adalat Ain. Admittedly the aforesaid Misc. Case No.26 of 1992 was filed under Order IX rule 13 of the Code of Civil Procedure which has not been made applicable in such a proceeding prior to 17.7.1992. This Court earlier in another application under section 115 of the Code of Civil Procedure by Hafizul Islam and another opined that all the provisions of the Code of Civil Procedure have not been made applicable in a case filed before an Artha Rin Adalat. In that decision we found that the provision of Order 47 rule 1 read with section 151 of the Code of Civil Procedure is not available to the aggrieved party. In view of our aforesaid decision we hold that the Misc. Case filed before 17th July, 1992 is not competent and consequently this court cannot entertain the appeal filed against the order dated 20.1.94 passed under Order IX rule 13 of the Code of Civil Procedure.
